title: Jeremy Clarkson details farm struggles amid UK heatwave
summary: Jeremy Clarkson has provided an update on his Diddly Squat Farm, describing the impact of the hot weather. The farm is facing challenges due to punishing droughts and high temperatures. Clarkson shared a "crushing" and "bleak" outlook for the farm's operations.
summary_points: Jeremy Clarkson shared an update on his Diddly Squat Farm.
The farm is experiencing difficulties due to hot weather.
Punishing droughts and high temperatures are affecting the farm.
Clarkson described the situation as "crushing" and "bleak".
